sections.description:
YZ Chatbot transforms your WordPress website into an intelligent customer service platform powered by Google Gemini AI. No coding required – just install, connect, and your AI assistant is ready to help your customers 24/7.

🚀 Why YZ Chatbot?

  • 30-Second Setup – No technical knowledge needed
  • Google Gemini AI – Latest AI technology for natural conversations
  • 24/7 Availability – Never miss a customer inquiry
  • 40+ Languages – Automatic language detection
  • WooCommerce Ready – Automatically learns your products

✨ Key Features

🤖 AI-Powered Responses
Intelligent, context-aware answers powered by Google Gemini. Your chatbot understands your business and provides accurate information.

🌍 Multilingual Support
Supports 40+ languages including Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, and more. Automatically detects visitor language.

📱 Mobile Optimized
Beautiful, responsive design that works perfectly on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile.

🎨 Fully Customizable
Match your brand with custom colors, themes (light/dark/auto), and positioning options.

📊 Analytics Dashboard
Track conversations, customer satisfaction, and chatbot performance with detailed analytics.

🔒 GDPR/KVKK Compliant
Built-in cookie consent and data privacy features to meet regulatory requirements.

🛒 WooCommerce Integration
Automatically syncs with your WooCommerce store. Chatbot can answer questions about products, prices, and availability.

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores
  • Service businesses
  • Restaurants & cafes
  • Hotels & hospitality
  • Healthcare providers
  • Educational institutions
  • Real estate agencies
  • And many more…

🔧 How It Works

  1. Install – Add the plugin to your WordPress site
  2. Connect – Link your YapayZekaChatbot account (free trial available)
  3. Customize – Set your preferred colors and position
  4. Go Live – Your AI assistant starts helping customers immediately

🎁 Free Trial

Start with a 14-day free trial – no credit card required. Experience the full power of AI customer service before committing.

Start Free Trial →

📚 Resources

  • Documentation
  • Live Demo
  • Support Center
  • Pricing Plans

Privacy Policy

YZ Chatbot connects to the YapayZekaChatbot API to provide AI-powered chat functionality. User data is subject to the YapayZekaChatbot privacy policy.

Data Collected:
* Chat conversations (for customer support)
* Anonymous visitor analytics
* Widget configuration settings

Data Storage:
* All data is stored on secure servers
* Data is not shared with third parties
* Users can request data deletion

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “YZ Chatbot”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Follow the setup wizard

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Create a free account at yapayzekachatbot.com/kayit
  2. Copy your Tenant ID from the dashboard
  3. Paste it in the plugin settings
  4. Enable the widget and save
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes, the WordPress plugin is completely free. The AI chatbot service requires a YapayZekaChatbot subscription. We offer a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

What languages does it support?

YZ Chatbot supports 40+ languages including Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and many more. The chatbot automatically detects the visitor’s language.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! YZ Chatbot integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce. It automatically learns about your products and can answer customer questions about pricing, availability, and product details.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The widget loads asynchronously and doesn’t affect your page load speed. It uses lazy loading to ensure optimal performance.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. YZ Chatbot includes built-in cookie consent features and complies with GDPR, KVKK, and other data privacy regulations. All data is stored securely.

Can I customize the appearance?

Absolutely! You can customize:
– Colors (primary color picker)
– Theme (light, dark, or auto)
– Position (bottom-right or bottom-left)
– Welcome message
– And more from the dashboard

Can I use it on multiple websites?

Yes, you can use YZ Chatbot on multiple websites. Each site needs its own Tenant ID. The number of sites depends on your subscription plan.

How do I get support?

Visit our Support Center or use the live chat on our website. We’re here to help!
